retainedMemory.scope: Main-page heap after explicit GC after each operation, outside its elapsed timer. GC changes subsequent operation conditions; these timings are not comparable with ordinary runs. Native/process allocations are excluded. Optional worker records report each worker isolate separately after GC; ended workers are marked explicitly.

scope: Headless Chromium UI import and Undo/Redo through durable save; automation latency included. RAF gaps during operations are not orbit FPS; heap is sampled with separate forced-GC diagnostics.
heapScope: Samples after each operation only; not peak process memory.
